# Breaks tests/bats-style.bats on purpose: line 9 is a bare ! in a test body.
# The helper on line 4 keeps its ! as a return value and must not be flagged.

refuses() { ! grep -q yes "$1"; }

@test "a test that cannot fail on its negative" {
  local f="${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR}/f"
  echo yes >"$f"
  ! grep -q yes "$f"
  [ -s "$f" ]
}
